messages:
ava: Spot check: after yesterday's SDK rollout we got several reports of malformed function-call payloads when using llama3x-chat in eu-west. Small but real uptick in bad_responses metric. Thinking an SDK compatibility pin/advisory until we patch.

mike: Can we do an SDK-level soft-pin so auto-upgrades are blocked in eu-west only? That would be lower blast radius than pinning runtime or model.

jorge: Agreed. Root cause seems to be a subtle change in JSON-escaping for function args in SDK 3.4 that runtime v4.0 wasn't normalizing. We can ship a runtime tolerant patch, but easier to hold SDK upgrades until fix lands.

ava: OK: plan: 1) post SDK advisory scoped to eu-west and affected orgs; 2) block auto-upgrade flows for SDK 3.4 in that region; 3) add a release-note blurb and support template. We'll unpin once runtime patch v4.0.1 rolls and we validate.

deploybot: Automated: compatibility advisory posted -> target=sdk:3.4, region=eu-west, id=adv-6312349998, started=2026-03-22T21:05Z. Auto-upgrade blocked for advisory scope. To clear: `/adv clear adv-6312349998` (eng-releases approval required).

oncall-bot: Alert: bad_response_rate increased to 2.3% in eu-west after SDK 3.4 exposures. Monitoring extended to 30m.

mike: Eng-platform: can you add a short note to console and a banner for affected orgs? Also add an opt-out flag for advanced users who want to keep SDK 3.4.

eng-platform: Release notes and console banner updated: "Compatibility advisory: SDK 3.4 holds in eu-west due to function-call JSON-escaping change leading to malformed args for runtime v4.0. Workaround: pin SDK to 3.3 or set client flag `fc_legacy_escaping=true`. We will lift the hold after runtime v4.0.1 is validated in canary." Support templates drafted.

jorge: Runtime patch ETA ~2 hours. Once we push v4.0.1 to canary we'll run a 1-hour smoke with synthetic function calls. If green, post lift note and remove advisory.

ava: Leaving advisory active. If bad_response rate drops <0.5% within 60m we can consider lowering severity, but keep auto-upgrade blocked until we lift explicitly. Will update thread when we unpin or escalate. :white_check_mark:
